## Materials


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| workflow | metallic-roughness PBR; opaque by default |
| texture channels | basecolor; normal; orm; emission |
| orm | R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic; scalar channels linear |
| color space | basecolor/emission sRGB; normal/ORM linear |
| normal convention | glTF tangent-space +Y |
| texture dimensions | power of two; choose actual sizes by measured phone result, no invented final budget |
| alpha | opaque or deliberate mask; blended fur cards require measured justification |
| export | GLB embeds validated textures; no external arbitrary source paths, cameras or lights |
